opening.argument: The material presents Gigamax as a “100% legit” arbitrage bot while directing viewers to register and deposit money: “If you want to register, you can deposit $50.” The registration screen requests full name, username, phone, email, passwords, a USDT address, and a referral ID, while the platform displays a minimum USDT deposit and controls to return, confirm, and proceed. It also displays purported arbitrage-withdrawal amounts, including 86.23 and 241.00, alongside language linking use of deposited money to profit. Together, these are concrete solicitation and participation mechanics, not merely discussion of trading. The material does not establish that any deposit, withdrawal, profit, or credential use was completed or genuine.
